capabilities: Trigger actions by pressing two to four keys simultaneously
Insert text snippets and place the cursor with a {c} tag
Paste file contents as a chord action
Run commands and insert Templater templates via chords
Limit chords to the editor or allow them in other text fields
extras: The README warns that the plugin works through text replacement and advises backing up the vault before installing; a demo image is referenced but not included in the text.
problem: Obsidian hotkeys require modifier keys (Ctrl, Alt, Shift) and are limited to commands, so frequently repeated text or template insertion lacks a fast trigger.

relations.evidence: Template: (Requires Templater) Pastes the contents of a template.

summary: Chord-based trigger plugin that inserts text, pastes file contents, or runs commands when several keys are pressed at once.
